messages:
Maya: Heads-up 1: we need a compact battlecard refresh for SDRs + a 2-slide webinar narrative + a light benchmark blurb for the blog by EOD Friday.
Jason: Got it. Proposed posture vs cloud vendors: predictable cost + graceful degradation, not just raw speed.
Li: Add a technical hook vs LLM APIs: routing + quantization choices that reduce tail latency. Example claim: 'engineered for stable P99s under burst.'
Sophie: For SDR copy avoid hard numbers. Use 'industry-grade latency SLAs' and link to a detailed benchmark appendix for engineers.
Carl: For infra vendors emphasize ops savings: 'we handle kernel selection, autoscaling, and KV cache so your engs build features.' Short bullets.
Maya: Draft three punchlines: Economics, Reliability, Dev velocity. Each 1-liner + one proof point.
Jason: Economics: "Turn variable token spend into engineering-friendly predictability reserve & burst model." :money_with_wings:
Li: Reliability: "Automated fallbacks and region-aware routing keep flows alive during incidents." :satellite:
Sophie: Dev velocity: "One API across hosted/dedicated/private test once, deploy anywhere." :rocket:
Maya: Webinar slides: slide1=problem + customer cost vignette; slide2=solution + 5-min demo (canary rollback to quantized model). Carl can record demo.
Carl: Ill record a 10min demo Wednesday. Need infra time.
Jason: SDR one-pager bullets: 1) What we do (1 line); 2) Why it matters (latency/cost/reliability); 3) Proof points (benchmarks + quote); 4) CTA: benchmark link + webinar sign-up.
Sophie: Add two objection-handlers: "Why not just vendor X?" -> predictable SLOs & fallbacks. "On-prem?" -> Private deployment + managed control plane.
Li: I'll draft a tiny reproducibility snippet for engineers to run the benchmark locally (appendix only).
Maya: ops-bot, please schedule a reminder: deck review Thurs 10am.
ops-bot: Reminder set for #marketing: "Battlecard + webinar deck review" Thu 10:00.
Maya: Next steps: Carl (demo record by Wed), Li (benchmark appendix Wed EOD), Sophie (SDR one-pager Thu AM), Jason (routing playbook Thu midday). I'll assemble slides and circulate.
Jason: :thumbsup:
Maya: Tagging @Jason @Li @Sophie @Carl thanks everyone.
